feeds.what: every state-level contest of the election in one document (statewide totals, with a per-count-group breakdown per choice; no per-county rows)
feeds.notes: Standard Enhanced Voting shape: /results/public/api/elections/<slug>/<publicElectionId>/data with slug 'Georgia'. 1,303,481 bytes decoded, 61,202 on the wire (gzip). Cache-Control: public, max-age=60. election.publishVersionId changes on each publish.

feeds.what: the list of every election the state has on this site (118 entries, newest first)
feeds.notes: elections[] of {publicElectionId, electionDate, name[], dateText[]}. NOTE: the older list path /results/public/api/elections/Georgia answers 404 here (headers saved as elections-list-404.headers.txt).

feeds.what: media export: statewide results plus all 159 counties' results (localResults[]) in one file
feeds.notes: 47,494,814 bytes (served as application/octet-stream, not compressed), so only the first 1 MB is kept. Path comes from jurisdiction.mediaExportPath ('Georgia/export-11032026GeneralAndSpecialElection.json') in the data document, under /cdn/results/. Top level: electionDate, electionName, createdAt, results{id,name,ballotItems[273],reportingStatuses[]}, localResults[159]{id,name,ballotItems[],reportingStatuses[]}. Simpler field names than /data (name is a plain string, ids like 'US2'). Too big for a relay to poll; use /data.

election_id: 11032026GeneralAndSpecialElection (the site calls it publicElectionId). It is the last path segment of the page URL and sits between the slug and /data in the API URL.
discovery: GET https://results.sos.ga.gov/results/public/api/jurisdictions/Georgia and read elections[] (publicElectionId + electionDate). Ids are hand-typed and follow no pattern (2024NovGen, GeneralPrimary51926, 11032026GeneralAndSpecialElection), so they must be looked up by electionDate, never constructed.
cors: none on /data and /jurisdictions (no Access-Control-Allow-Origin in the 200 answers when sent Origin: https://openslate.us). The 47 MB media export under /cdn/results/ answers access-control-allow-origin: *.
bot_blocking: Plain relay User-Agent: 200 on every request (page, /data, /jurisdictions, media export). Site is behind Cloudflare (Server: cloudflare, cf-cache-status: DYNAMIC) in front of Azure Front Door, and the page injects Cloudflare's JS-detection script, but no challenge was served. Browser User-Agent not needed, not tried.
updated_field: election.asOf, e.g. '2026-11-10T22:30:12.40547Z' (UTC, ISO 8601 with Z). Also election.lastUpdated '2026-11-10T22:28:22.2933153Z' and election.publishDate '2026-11-10T22:31:52.6882792Z'; each ballotItem has reportingStatus.asOf.
reporting_field: Per contest: ballotItems[].reportingStatus.reportingUnits / totalUnits, counted in COUNTIES, not precincts (US Senate: 159 / 159; US House District 1: 15 / 15). Per county: jurisdiction.childLocalities[].percentReporting and precinctsReporting as fractions 0..1 (Appling: 1.0). election.precinctsReporting is null at state level.

state_upper: State Senate - District 5/ Senador Estatal del Distrito 5

choice_format: Party is inside the name text and also a separate object: name[0].text 'Mike Collins (Rep)' with party.abbreviation 'Rep'; incumbents carry '(I)' before the party: 'Jon Ossoff (I) (Dem)'. Measures are ballotOptions named 'Yes' and 'No' with an empty-named party; note a measure's contestType is 'Candidate' too, and referendum[] is empty, so measures can only be told apart by title or by the Yes/No options.
district_field: Only in the title ('… - District 7'). No separate district field. Districts that touch Gwinnett County carry a Spanish suffix in the title ('State Senate - District 5/ Senador Estatal del Distrito 5'), so parse the number with a pattern like /District (\d+)/.
terms: none found on the results site (the page has no terms or robots statement; not searched further on sos.ga.gov)
